{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.00

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Returns a list of named properties on Geometry LOD.

|s1= [[namedProperties]] object

|p1= object: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Array]]s of [[String]]s, in format: <nowiki>[</nowiki>[namedProperty1, propertyValue1], [namedProperty2, propertyValue2], ...]

|s2= object [[namedProperties]] [LOD]

|s2since= arma3 2.14

|p21= object: [[Object]]

|p22= LOD: [[String]] or [[Number]] - can be one of:
* {{hl|"Memory"}}
* {{hl|"Geometry"}}
* {{hl|"FireGeometry"}}
* {{hl|"LandContact"}}
* {{hl|"HitPoints"}}
* {{hl|"ViewGeometry"}}
When [[Number]] is used, command searches for a LOD with the similar [[LOD resolutions|LOD resolution]]

|r2= [[HashMap]]

|x1= <sqf>private _properties = namedProperties _object; // [["sbsource","shadowvolume"],["prefershadowvolume","1"],["reversed","1"],["buoyancy","1"]]</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>private _namedProperties = cursorObject namedProperties ["FireGeometry"];</sqf>

|seealso= [[selectionNames]] [[animationNames]] [[Arma 3: Named Properties]] [[allLODs]]
